profile.description: Profile vault name (e.g. default, dev, prod)

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the snapshot was created

trigger_reason.description: Reason for creation (e.g. manual, auto-save, pre-migration, pre-restore-safety)

actor.description: Origin of the operation (e.g. terminal, ai-agent, web-ui, system)

secret_count.description: Total active secrets in snapshot (-1 if locked/key mismatch)

file_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the encrypted snapshot .enc file

key_match.description: True if snapshot masterKey SHA256 matches active Touch ID master key
